notes.title: RELEASE NOTES - Oct 13 2021 (0.114)
notes.notes:
Welcome to Space Merchant!

RELEASE NOTES - Oct 1 2021 (0.113)

*MISC. IMPROVEMENTS*
PC release (available on Steam)
Added Queues for Builder and Aerospace
Increased craft time for buildings and ships
Updated UI for ship blueprints

*BUG FIXES*
Fixed inventory crashes
Removed demo notification
Fixed crashes when selecting a person
Fixed incorrect icons for ships when traveling
UI fixes for Aerospace, Buildings, Research etc.
Fixed crash when selecting empty station space

notes.title: Space Merchant on Steam!
notes.notes:
After 2 1/2 years of beta on mobile, Space Merchant is ready for Steam! 
The game includes Cloud Save in app for transferring save files from one platform to another. 

[b]Let us know in the comments what features you'd like to see on the Steam version! [/b]
